projects.title: Modular Rocket System
projects.description: Designed and 3D-printed a modular rocket system that adapts to different flight conditions, payloads, and environmental factors. The system uses standardized components and quick-connect mechanisms for rapid assembly and testing.

projects.title: Telemetry Lost
projects.description: Designed and built a text-based RPG game based on Mickey 7 by Edward Ashton. The game features a branching narrative, multiple endings, and a combat system that combines strategy and chance.

projects.title: AstroForge
projects.description: Developed an AI-assisted rocket construction and simulation game where players design, test, and iterate on rocket builds for different mission goals.
accomplishments: Built a playable rocket construction and simulation experience
Implemented AI-assisted design concepts for rocket configurations
Designed gameplay loops around test, refine, and relaunch

projects.title: VENA
projects.description: Co-created VENA, an entrepreneurship app concept that uses AI-powered image analysis to support injury triage workflows and user guidance.
accomplishments: Led architecture and core engineering decisions
Built an early AI image analysis pipeline for injury classification
Translated customer discovery into product requirements

images.caption: VENA app concept and prototype work

projects.title: Niryo Robot Barista Automation
projects.description: Built a coffee-making workflow with a Niryo robotic arm, integrating repeatable motion sequences and task automation for a practical robotics demo.
accomplishments: Programmed robotic arm motion paths for drink preparation steps
Demonstrated reliable end-to-end coffee task automation
